chapter: Italy and the future of New Orleans jazz
title: Jazz musicians and opera; the old French Opera House
summary: They discuss jazzmen listening to opera, the American premieres of Italian operas at the French Opera House, and rumours of a new building.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Those guys listen to opera. Bechet used to go down. Oh, yeah. The jazz musicians here. Obviously, they listen to opera. Oh, of course. And of course, we had that French opera here, which presented all kind of opera. You know, many of the famous Italian operas had their premiere at the French opera.
Oh, right. For this country. For this country.
That's something that people really aren't aware of.

No. Especially people in New York. Tell them something like that. They say, what? It's true. A lot of American premieres of operas have taken place right here in New Orleans at the old French opera house. By the way, do you think they'll ever rebuild a new French opera house? I've heard rumors the other day that they might.
With Permanentoulo, something's going to happen. Are they going to build a hotel?
